candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vestník verejného obstarávania (Public Procurement Bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication venue for all SK contracting-authority notices. Notices for banking/payment services (card acquiring, payment gateway, cash handling, core banking) name the buyer, the named contact person (kontaktná osoba) with function/e-mail/phone, and in award notices the winning supplier. This yields both buyer-side function owners and vendor org signals without any private-bank cooperation.
candidates.access_status: public, free; site occasionally returns errors/bot-defence on direct fetch
candidates.legal_status: official public register under Act 343/2015 Z. z.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic keyword+CPV crawl of the bulletin search UI (CPV 66110000 banking services, 66172000 financial transaction processing, 79940000, 30162000; terms 'platobné služby', 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'platobná brána'); parse contact-person block from each notice. Prefer ÚVO open-data datasets where available.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ÚVO site sections
queries_used: Vestník verejného obstarávania ÚVO platobné služby akceptácia platobných kariet banka
candidates.observed_blocker: root https://www.uvo.gov.sk/ appeared in search results with an 'Error' page title — treat as unverified, not dead

candidates.source_name: ÚVO – Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (tender search)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured search front-end over the bulletin; the practical entry point for repeatable filtered queries by CPV, contracting authority (SZRB, Eximbanka, Štátna pokladnica, Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa, Slovenská pošta) and subject matter.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised HTTP queries per contracting authority IČO + CPV; snapshot result lists weekly, diff for new notices.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tender.sk verejnesutaze.sk agregátor verejné obstarávanie Slovensko API dáta

candidates.source_name: IS EVO / elektronická platforma (Úrad vlády SR)
candidates.why_relevant: EVO is the state e-procurement platform (administration moved to Úrad vlády SR on 31.3.2022). It routes ~45% of in-scope contracts and points to where tender documentation, Q&A and bidder identities live; the documentation (súťažné podklady) often contains the buyer's internal org chart and role names for payment operations.
candidates.access_status: public browsing; some documents require registration/login
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Follow notice-level links from the Vestník into the platform; download published súťažné podklady where anonymous access allowed.
queries_used: Josephine eranet ERANET elektronické verejné obstarávanie EVO uvo.gov.sk portál platforma banka

candidates.source_name: JOSEPHINE / Eranet / Tendernet / EVOservis – private e-procurement platforms used by SK authorities
candidates.why_relevant: A large minority of SK tenders (JOSEPHINE ~22%, Eranet ~8% of e-procurement) are run outside EVO. Slovenská pošta runs its own Eranet instance (posta.eranet.sk). Missing these platforms means missing the tender documentation and bidder lists for state-linked financial actors.
candidates.access_status: public listing pages; bidding requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Maintain a per-authority map of which platform they use (from the notice's 'komunikácia' field), then crawl each authority's public profile page.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from platform-market-share article and Slovenská pošta procurement page
queries_used: Josephine eranet ERANET elektronické verejné obstarávanie EVO uvo.gov.sk portál platforma banka
Slovenská pošta Poštová banka zmluva verejné obstarávanie hotovostné operácie tender

candidates.source_name: TED / eNotices2 – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU), Slovakia filter
candidates.why_relevant: Above-threshold SK notices are mirrored to TED with structured XML/eForms, including CPV 66110000 (banking services), 66172000 (financial transaction processing/clearing) and named contact points. TED is far more machine-friendly than ÚVO and gives cross-border visibility of who bids for SK payment-services contracts.
candidates.source_subtype: EU procurement database with open API/bulk data
candidates.access_status: public, free; official search API and bulk XML downloads
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication (Publications Office); open reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API expert query: country=SVK AND CPV in (66110000, 66111000, 66172000, 66151000, 30162000, 72212440) — schedule daily; parse organisation and contact-point sections from eForms XML.
queries_used: TED tenders europa eu Slovakia payment services acquiring contract notice bank CPV 66110000

candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – Central Register of Contracts
candidates.why_relevant: All contracts of ministries, central bodies, public-law institutions and >50%-state-owned entities must be published here and only become effective the day after publication (Act 546/2010, §5a Act 211/2000). Contracts for payment gateways, card acquiring, cash logistics and core banking are therefore obtainable in full text, with signatories, prices and responsible-person names — a direct read on both buyer org structure and incumbent vendors. Notable exception: NBS is exempt.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-text search on 'platobná brána', 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'zúčtovanie', 'POS terminál', 'prepočet hotovosti', plus per-IČO filters for SZRB/Eximbanka/ŠP/SP/FR SR/Slovenská pošta; harvest PDF attachments and diff monthly.
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva platobná brána banka

candidates.source_name: Zmluvy.gov.sk – CRZ per-institution contract listings
candidates.why_relevant: Alternate CRZ front-end organised by institution (e.g. Slovenská pošta, a.s. listing), making per-actor contract monitoring simpler than the main CRZ search.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bookmark per-institution IDs and poll listing pages.
queries_used: Slovenská pošta Poštová banka zmluva verejné obstarávanie hotovostné operácie tender

candidates.source_name: eGovZmluvy / zmluvy.egov.sk – municipal contract register (CRZ-linked)
candidates.why_relevant: Municipalities, VÚC and their organisations publish here; they are heavy buyers of card-acceptance and payment-gateway services (e.g. town of Trebišov's 'Zmluva o akceptácii platobných kariet'). Reveals which banks/PSPs win the long tail of SK public-sector acquiring and who signs on both sides.
candidates.legal_status: statutory publication via commercial register operator
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword sweep on 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'platobný terminál', 'platobná brána'; sample-based rather than exhaustive.
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva platobná brána banka
Vestník verejného obstarávania ÚVO platobné služby akceptácia platobných kariet banka

candidates.source_name: UVOstat – aggregated ÚVO + CRZ data with API
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party aggregator that joins tender notices, contract register and buyer↔supplier relationship graphs, with a documented API (free /api/subjekty tier, paid for the rest). Dramatically cheaper than scraping ÚVO directly and exposes supplier-concentration patterns that reveal vendor org footprints.
candidates.access_status: free browsing + free subjekty API with token; other endpoints paid
candidates.legal_status: derived from open public data; check ToS before bulk reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for ApiToken; pull entity profiles for state-linked financial actors and their suppliers; supplement with HTML pages for procurement lists.
candidates.discovered_via_method: aggregator-landscape search + snowball to GitHub API docs
queries_used: uvostat.sk tender.sk verejnesutaze.sk agregátor verejné obstarávanie Slovensko API dáta

candidates.source_name: Verejnesutaze.sk – EPVO/EKS/ÚVO tender aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Consolidates notices from EPVO, EKS and ÚVO into one searchable feed with alerting; useful as a cross-check that no payment-services tender was missed across the fragmented platform landscape.
candidates.access_status: free tier after registration; premium paid
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Set keyword alerts as a redundancy layer; do not treat as primary.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tender.sk verejnesutaze.sk agregátor verejné obstarávanie Slovensko API dáta

candidates.source_name: Národný katalóg otvorených dát – ÚVO datasets (data.slovensko.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Official open-data catalogue entry listing ÚVO's published datasets — the legitimate bulk route into bulletin data, avoiding scraping and bot defences.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve distribution URLs from the catalogue record and schedule bulk downloads; prefer over HTML scraping.
queries_used: uvostat.sk tender.sk verejnesutaze.sk agregátor verejné obstarávanie Slovensko API dáta

candidates.source_name: SZRB – Vedenie banky (Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka leadership page)
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned bank's own published predstavenstvo (management board) and dozorná rada (supervisory board) roster — primary evidence of leadership moves. Current listing shows Radko Kuruc as chairman/GR, Daniela Klučková as supervisory-board chair. Changes here are driven by MF SR shareholder decisions, giving early warning of political-cycle turnover.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML snapshot + diff of /vedenie-banky/ and /informacie-o-banke/; pair with výročné správy PDFs for org-structure detail.
queries_used: SZRB vedenie banky predstavenstvo dozorná rada výročná správa organizačná zmena
SZRB Eximbanka predstavenstvo vymenovanie generálny riaditeľ vláda 2025

candidates.source_name: EXIMBANKA SR – Vedenie (leadership page)
candidates.why_relevant: Export-import bank's own board roster. Leadership is appointed/dismissed by the government (vláda SR) on MF SR proposal, so this page is the authoritative post-change record; recent turnover (Janočko → Podhorec, plus deputy GR Milan Horváth and board member Igor Lichnovský) shows high churn and confirms it as a live A5 signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly snapshot/diff; cross-check against vláda SR meeting outputs (rokovania.gov.sk) for the appointment decision itself.
queries_used: SZRB Eximbanka predstavenstvo vymenovanie generálny riaditeľ vláda 2025

candidates.source_name: MF SR – organizácie s účasťou štátu / výkon akcionárskych práv (SZRB, Eximbanka)
candidates.why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance is the shareholder/founder for SZRB and Eximbanka and the budget chapter owner for Štátna pokladnica and Finančná správa. Its pages enumerate the state-linked financial actors in scope and its press releases announce leadership changes (e.g. 'Nové vedenie Štátnej pokladnice'). This is the canonical actor-map pointer for the whole cell.
candidates.source_subtype: ministry portal / shareholder disclosures + press releases
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the two org-list pages to maintain the actor map; subscribe to /sk/media/tlacove-spravy/ and filter for the actor names and terms 'vymenoval', 'nové vedenie', 'odvolal'.
queries_used: SZRB Eximbanka predstavenstvo vymenovanie generálny riaditeľ vláda 2025

candidates.source_name: Štátna pokladnica – Štatút a Organizačný poriadok ŠP
candidates.why_relevant: The Treasury publishes both its statute and its full organizačný poriadok as PDFs, naming the management tiers (riaditeľ ŠP → riaditeľ odboru → vedúci oddelenia) and the departments that own payment operations and client accounts. Dated versions (2023, 2025) allow direct diffing of organization changes over time — an unusually explicit A5 signal.
candidates.source_subtype: statute / internal organizational rules published as PDF
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll /o_nas/ document directory for new dated versions; extract org-unit tree from PDF and diff against the prior edition; supplement with Správa o činnosti ŠP annual reports.
queries_used: Štátna pokladnica organizačná štruktúra vedenie Sociálna poisťovňa Finančná správa platobný styk

candidates.source_name: Štátna pokladnica – Osobitné podmienky pre poskytovanie služieb platobnej brány ŠP
candidates.why_relevant: The Treasury operates its own payment gateway for public-sector clients and publishes its terms and pricing. These documents identify the technical/processing arrangement behind SK public-sector e-payments and the ŠP unit that owns it — directly relevant to who the function owners are and which vendors sit underneath.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Version-track the vseobecne_podmienky and cennik_urokove_sadzby document folders; diff for changed contact units and service scope.
candidates.discovered_via_method: surfaced by the payment-services seed query, then snowballed within pokladnica.sk

candidates.source_name: Finančná správa SR – Organizačný poriadok FR SR (Predstavitelia document series)
candidates.why_relevant: FR SR publishes its full organizational rules in a dated document folder (at least two 2025 editions: 2025.04.09 and 2025.11.07), setting out internal units, management authority and responsibilities. Frequent re-issues make this a high-resolution organization-change tracker for the largest state financial-administration body, and the '/Predstavitelia/' path also carries leadership documents.
candidates.source_subtype: internal organizational rules published as dated PDFs
candidates.access_status: public PDF; parent site can be slow/bot-defended
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the /Dokumenty_PFS/Financna_sprava/Predstavitelia/<year>/ directory annually, download each dated OP revision, diff org-unit trees; watch for prezident finančnej správy appointment (appointed/dismissed by minister of finance).
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball on document path pattern

candidates.source_name: Sociálna poisťovňa – Organizačná štruktúra a Generálny riaditeľ
candidates.why_relevant: Sociálna poisťovňa publishes its org structure and a dedicated GR page; the GR is appointed/dismissed by the government, so changes are politically driven and well-signalled. It is also one of SK's largest originators of mass payment flows (benefits disbursement), making its payment-operations units and their tenders commercially significant.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Snapshot/diff the org-structure and GR pages; also harvest branch-director rosters (personálne obsadenie funkcií riaditeľov pobočiek) tabled in NR SR documents.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball to NR SR annex document

candidates.source_name: Slovenská pošta – Verejné obstarávanie / profil obstarávateľa
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenská pošta is the physical distribution arm of the postal-banking nexus (historic Poštová banka relationship, cash deposits/withdrawals at post offices). Its own procurement profile lists above-threshold contracts and, since 1.8.2021, routes them via posta.eranet.sk. Its tenders for cash handling, counter systems and payment terminals name incumbent suppliers and buyer-side owners.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the nadlimitné-zákazky listing and the posta.eranet.sk public record endpoints; correlate awards with CRZ contract full texts.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball to the entity's own eranet instance

candidates.source_name: CISŠS – Register výberových konaní v štátnej službe
candidates.why_relevant: Central statutory registry of civil-service selection procedures, published at least 15 working days before the procedure. For Finančná správa, Štátna pokladnica and ministry units this is the cleanest hiring/jobs signal in the cell — vacancy titles disclose new or restructured units (e.g. payment-operations, eKasa, IT platform roles) before any org chart is republished.
candidates.legal_status: statutory register under the civil service act
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of the published list filtered by služobný úrad (FR SR, MF SR, ŠP) and by keywords 'platob', 'karta', 'pokladni', 'eKasa', 'IT'; store title + unit + deadline and diff.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search for SK public-sector selection-procedure registries

candidates.why_relevant: Any vendor contracting with the SK state above thresholds must register its beneficial owners and its authorised person (oprávnená osoba). For payment/banking suppliers this exposes ownership chains, group structure and the responsible verifying party — an indirect but authoritative read on vendor organization changes, and it links directly to who wins ÚVO/CRZ contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Look up each supplier IČO harvested from ÚVO/CRZ awards; snapshot the verification documents (verifikačné dokumenty), which often narrate group structure and management.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search on SK beneficial-ownership registers, snowballed from procurement rules

candidates.why_relevant: Think-tank database documenting appointment/dismissal mechanics, tenure and turnover of heads of SK state institutions. Gives the structural rules (who appoints whom, for how long) that let you anticipate leadership churn rather than only observe it.

candidates.why_relevant: Anti-corruption NGO and investigative outlets (SME Index, Pravda) analyse specific state-entity tenders — e.g. a Slovenská pošta tender challenged for specification steering — and in doing so name incumbent suppliers, decision-makers and the internal units that ran the procurement. Useful for interpreting an award that the formal record leaves opaque.

negative_findings.description: The ÚVO root domain https://www.uvo.gov.sk/ surfaced in search results with an 'Error' page title, and section URLs were reachable only indirectly via search snippets during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as unverified, not dead. ÚVO is a statutory portal and is near-certainly live; the symptom is consistent with bot-defence, transient outage or a redirect. Liveness must be settled by the deterministic verification pass, and an open-data / TED fallback route is already listed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Declaring the primary SK procurement portal dead on one bad signal would break the whole public-portal route for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a central SK registry of political/board nominations to state-owned enterprises (the 'nominacie.gov.sk' hypothesis) that would consolidate appointments to SZRB, Eximbanka and similar.
negative_findings.result_summary: No such consolidated nominations register was found. Civil-service vacancies are centralised at cisss.gov.sk, but board appointments to state-owned banks are decided by the vláda SR and surface only in government session records, MF SR press releases, the institutions' own pages and news wires.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move tracking for state-linked banks cannot be single-sourced; it needs a multi-source watch (institution page + MF SR + wire) rather than one register poll.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a current contractual/ownership nexus between Slovenská pošta and Poštová banka covering cash operations at post-office counters.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found Poštová banka's own cash-operations product page and Slovenská pošta's procurement profile, plus a CRZ listing for Slovenská pošta, but no specific published contract between the two was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The post-office cash network is a major SK payments channel; the contractual arrangement must be located in CRZ full text rather than assumed, and remains an open collection task.

negative_findings.description: TED could not be queried with a live SK+CPV filter through generic web search; only TED's own help, CPV and sector-browse pages were retrievable.
negative_findings.result_summary: No actual SK payment-services notice was retrieved in this pass. The TED entry is recorded as a high-confidence structural source (official API/bulk data documented), not as a set of verified individual notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The candidate must be operationalised with real API queries before anyone assumes SK payment-services notices exist in volume on TED.

negative_findings.description: Leadership facts retrieved via search snippets carry uncertain dates (e.g. an SZRB board-change item that appears to date from 2012; Eximbanka items spanning 2022-2023).
negative_findings.result_summary: No leadership roster is recorded here as current. Only the source pages are recorded; the roster itself must be read fresh from the institution's own page at collection time.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A5 conclusions built on undated snippet-level leadership claims would be wrong; this is precisely why the primary governance pages are ranked above the news wires.

coverage_gaps.description: No source located in this pass for the governance/appointment record of the vláda SR session itself (rokovania.gov.sk) where SZRB/Eximbanka/Sociálna poisťovňa appointments are formally decided.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over rokovania.gov.sk and vlada.gov.sk materiály, searching 'vymenovanie', 'člen predstavenstva', 'generálny riaditeľ' plus the actor names; this is the primary-document layer beneath the news wires.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-handling / CIT (cash-in-transit) and ATM-estate tenders by state-linked actors were not systematically explored; only card acquiring and payment gateways were.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run CPV-driven sweeps for 79710000 (security services), 30123600 (coin-handling), 'prepočet a spracovanie hotovosti', 'bankomat', 'CIT' across ÚVO and CRZ.

coverage_gaps.description: No Hungarian-language or Roma-community-facing public-sector channels were checked, and no English-language SK government payment-procurement mirror beyond TED was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm whether any in-scope authority publishes English notice summaries; otherwise record sk-only as the operating assumption for the domestic layer.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear which ÚVO datasets in the national open-data catalogue actually carry contact-person fields, versus requiring notice-level HTML parsing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the catalogue distributions, sample one dataset, and document field coverage before committing to a bulk-data-only collection design.

coverage_gaps.description: Other state-adjacent financial actors were not explored: Slovenská konsolidačná, Slovak Investment Holding / SZRB Asset Management, VšZP (mass payment flows), and regional VÚC treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map from the MF SR org lists and run the same Vestník/CRZ/vacancy triad against each.

brief: The Slovak public-sector route is unusually rich for A5: three statutory layers stack cleanly — the ÚVO Vestník (plus TED for above-threshold notices) reveals who buys payment services and names the responsible contact person; the Centrálny register zmlúv publishes the resulting contracts in full text, since a state contract only takes effect the day after publication (NBS being the sole exemption); and CISŠS carries civil-service vacancies 15 working days ahead of selection. On the leadership side, the state-linked financial actors publish their own governance directly — SZRB and Eximbanka board rosters on szrb.sk/eximbanka.sk, and, more valuably, Štátna pokladnica and Finančná správa publish dated organizačný poriadok PDFs whose revisions can be diffed for real organization changes. Aggregators (UVOstat with an API, verejnesutaze.sk, the national open-data catalogue) make bulk collection feasible without scraping the ÚVO front-end, which returned an error during this pass and should be treated as unverified rather than dead. The main structural weakness is that appointments to state-owned banks have no single register: they must be triangulated across vláda SR session records, MF SR press releases, the institutions' own pages and TASR/SITA wires.
